applied.problem: The Wikipedia line is about heat lost by thermal radiation; dropping that qualifier makes the law sound useless for any real gap, including the lesson's own 70 °C one. Also e^(−1) is 0.3679…, so 'about', not 'equals', 0.368.
A part at around 90 °C does not glow: it radiates invisible infrared heat, and visible glowing only starts hundreds of degrees hotter, so 'glowing radiation' is misleading.

notes.problem: whatAmILookingAt and numbers describe R (10 to 200 kΩ) and C (10 to 1000 µF) sliders from screen 3, but controls lists only the time handle and the mode switch; the builder needs these sliders added.
